symbols.when: Use to update a `TxRef` and return a computed result from the same transaction step.

symbols.name: set
symbols.summary: Sets the value of the `TxRef`.
symbols.when: Use to replace the value of a `TxRef`.

symbols.name: TxRef
symbols.summary: TxRef is a transactional value, it can be read and modified within the body of a transaction.
symbols.when: Use to store mutable state that must be read and modified inside Effect transactions.

symbols.name: update
symbols.summary: Updates the value of the `TxRef` using the provided function.
symbols.when: Use to transform a `TxRef` when no result value is needed.

summary: Coordinates access to limited resources inside transactions.

symbols.name: acquire
symbols.summary: Acquires a single permit from the semaphore. If no permits are available, the effect will block until one becomes available.
symbols.when: Use to manually acquire one permit transactionally, waiting until one is available.

symbols.name: acquireN
symbols.summary: Acquires the specified number of permits from the semaphore.
symbols.when: Use to manually acquire multiple permits transactionally, waiting until all requested permits are available.

symbols.name: available
symbols.summary: Gets the current number of available permits in the semaphore.
symbols.when: Use to inspect how many permits are currently available.

symbols.name: capacity
symbols.summary: Gets the maximum capacity (total permits) of the semaphore.
symbols.when: Use to inspect the fixed total number of permits managed by the semaphore.

symbols.name: isTxSemaphore
symbols.summary: Determines if the provided value is a TxSemaphore.
symbols.when: Use to narrow an unknown value before treating it as a `TxSemaphore`.

symbols.name: make
symbols.summary: Creates a new TxSemaphore with the specified number of permits.
symbols.when: Use to create a transactional semaphore with a fixed permit capacity.

symbols.name: release
symbols.summary: Releases one permit back to the semaphore, making it available for acquisition.
symbols.when: Use to manually return one permit after a transactional acquire.

symbols.name: releaseN
symbols.summary: Releases the specified number of permits back to the semaphore.
symbols.when: Use to manually return multiple permits after a transactional acquire.

symbols.name: tryAcquire
symbols.summary: Tries to acquire a single permit from the semaphore without blocking, returning `true` if successful or `false` if no permits are available.
symbols.when: Use to attempt a single-permit acquisition without retrying when no permit is available.

symbols.name: tryAcquireN
symbols.summary: Tries to acquire the specified number of permits from the semaphore without blocking, returning `true` if successful or `false` if not enough permits are available.
symbols.when: Use to attempt a multi-permit acquisition without retrying when not enough permits are available.

symbols.name: TxSemaphore
symbols.summary: A transactional semaphore that manages permits using Software Transactional Memory (STM) semantics, providing atomic permit acquisition and release operations within Effect transactions for concurrency control over limited resources.
symbols.when: Use to coordinate permit accounting atomically with other transactional state changes.

symbols.name: withPermit
symbols.summary: Executes an effect with a single permit from the semaphore. The permit is automatically acquired before execution and released afterwards, even if the effect fails or is interrupted.
symbols.when: Use to run an effect while automatically acquiring and releasing one transactional permit.

symbols.name: withPermits
symbols.summary: Runs an effect while holding the specified number of permits from the semaphore.
symbols.when: Use to run an effect while automatically acquiring and releasing multiple transactional permits.

symbols.name: withPermitScoped
symbols.summary: Acquires a single permit from the semaphore in a scoped manner. The permit will be automatically released when the scope is closed, even if effects within the scope fail or are interrupted.
symbols.when: Use to acquire one transactional permit for the lifetime of the current scope.

summary: Stores transactional state and publishes committed changes.

symbols.name: changes
symbols.summary: Subscribes to all changes of the TxSubscriptionRef. Returns a scoped TxDequeue that first yields the current value, then every subsequent update.
symbols.when: Use to subscribe to `TxSubscriptionRef` committed changes through a scoped transactional queue.

symbols.name: changesStream
symbols.summary: Returns a Stream of all changes to the TxSubscriptionRef, starting with the current value followed by every subsequent update.
symbols.when: Use to consume `TxSubscriptionRef` committed changes as a `Stream`.

symbols.name: get
symbols.summary: Reads the current value of the TxSubscriptionRef.
symbols.when: Use to read the current `TxSubscriptionRef` value without subscribing to future changes.

symbols.name: getAndSet
symbols.summary: Gets the current value and sets a new value atomically. Publishes the new value to all subscribers.
symbols.when: Use to replace a `TxSubscriptionRef` value while returning the previous value and publishing the update to subscribers.

symbols.name: getAndUpdate
symbols.summary: Gets the current value and updates it using a function atomically. Publishes the new value to all subscribers.
symbols.when: Use to derive and publish a new `TxSubscriptionRef` value while returning the previous value.

symbols.name: isTxSubscriptionRef
symbols.summary: Checks whether the given value is a TxSubscriptionRef.
symbols.when: Use to narrow an unknown value before treating it as a `TxSubscriptionRef`.

symbols.name: make
symbols.summary: Creates a new TxSubscriptionRef with the specified initial value.
symbols.when: Use to create a `TxSubscriptionRef` that publishes every committed update to subscribers.

symbols.name: modify
symbols.summary: Modifies the value of the TxSubscriptionRef using a function that returns both a result and the new value. The new value is published to all subscribers atomically.
symbols.when: Use to compute a separate return value and next `TxSubscriptionRef` state in one transactional update.

symbols.name: set
symbols.summary: Sets the value of the TxSubscriptionRef and publishes the new value to all subscribers.
symbols.when: Use to replace the current `TxSubscriptionRef` value with a known value and publish it.

symbols.name: TxSubscriptionRef
symbols.summary: A TxSubscriptionRef is a transactional reference that allows subscribing to all committed changes. Subscribers receive the current value followed by every subsequent update via a transactional dequeue.
symbols.when: Use to store transactional state whose committed changes must be observable by subscribers.

symbols.name: update
symbols.summary: Updates the value of the TxSubscriptionRef using a function and publishes the new value to all subscribers.
symbols.when: Use to derive the next `TxSubscriptionRef` value from the current value and publish it.

symbols.name: updateAndGet
symbols.summary: Updates the value using a function and returns the new value. Publishes the new value to all subscribers.
symbols.when: Use to derive and publish a new `TxSubscriptionRef` value while returning that new value.

summary: Provides compile-time utility types for TypeScript.

symbols.name: Concurrency
symbols.summary: Describes the concurrency level for Effect operations that run multiple effects.
symbols.when: Use to type options that control how many effects may run at the same time.

symbols.name: Contravariant
symbols.summary: Function-type alias encoding contravariant variance for a phantom type parameter.
symbols.when: Use as a phantom field type to make a type parameter contravariant in input position.

symbols.name: Covariant
symbols.summary: Function-type alias encoding covariant variance for a phantom type parameter.
symbols.when: Use as a phantom field type to make a type parameter covariant in output position.

symbols.name: DeepMutable
symbols.summary: Recursively removes `readonly` from plain objects, arrays, tuples, `Map`, and `Set` while preserving opaque objects.
symbols.when: Use when you need a fully mutable version of deeply readonly structural data.

symbols.name: Equals
symbols.summary: Determines if two types are exactly equal at the type level.
symbols.when: Use to assert type equality in conditional types or type-level tests.

symbols.name: EqualsWith
symbols.summary: Determines if two types are equal, returning custom types for each case.
symbols.when: Use when you need a type-level if/else based on type equality.

symbols.name: ExcludeReason
symbols.summary: Excludes a specific reason variant by its `_tag` from an error's `reason` field.
symbols.when: Use when you need the remaining nested reason union type after removing variants handled by `_tag`, rather than the enclosing error type.

symbols.name: ExcludeTag
symbols.summary: Excludes members of a tagged union by their `_tag` value.
symbols.when: Use to remove tagged-union members whose `_tag` matches a specific value in type-level code.

symbols.name: ExtractReason
symbols.summary: Extracts a specific reason variant by its `_tag` from an error's `reason` field.
symbols.when: Use when you need the nested reason variant type itself, selected by `_tag`, rather than the enclosing error type.

symbols.name: ExtractTag
symbols.summary: Extracts a specific member of a tagged union by its `_tag` value.
symbols.when: Use to select tagged-union members whose `_tag` matches a specific value in type-level code.

symbols.name: Has
symbols.summary: Checks whether an object type contains any of the specified keys.
symbols.when: Use to branch type-level logic when at least one key from a candidate key set exists on an object type.

symbols.name: Invariant
symbols.summary: Function-type alias encoding invariant variance for a phantom type parameter.
symbols.when: Use as a phantom field type to make a type parameter invariant, neither covariant nor contravariant.

symbols.name: IsUnion
symbols.summary: Checks whether a type `T` is a union type.
symbols.when: Use to branch type-level logic depending on whether a type is a union.

symbols.name: MergeLeft
symbols.summary: Left-biased merge of two object types where keys from `Source` take precedence over `Target` on conflict.
symbols.when: Use when you want left-biased merging where the first argument wins.

symbols.name: MergeRight
symbols.summary: Right-biased merge of two object types where keys from `Source` take precedence over `Target` on conflict.
symbols.when: Use when you want right-biased merging where the second argument wins.

symbols.name: Mutable
symbols.summary: Removes `readonly` from all properties of `T`. Supports arrays, tuples, and records.
symbols.when: Use when you need a mutable version of a readonly type.

symbols.name: NarrowReason
symbols.summary: Narrows a specific reason variant by its `_tag` from an error's `reason` field.
symbols.when: Use to preserve the original error shape while narrowing its nested reason field to the matching variant.

symbols.name: NoExcessProperties
symbols.summary: Constrains a type to prevent excess properties not present in `T`.
symbols.when: Use to catch accidental extra properties in generic functions at compile time.

symbols.name: NoInfer
symbols.summary: Prevents TypeScript from inferring a type parameter from a specific position.
symbols.when: Use when a function parameter must match an inferred type without becoming an inference source.

symbols.name: NotFunction
symbols.summary: Excludes function types from a union, keeping only non-function members.
symbols.when: Use to filter out callable types from a union.

symbols.name: OmitReason
symbols.summary: Narrows an error's `reason` field to exclude a specific reason variant by its `_tag`.
symbols.when: Use to narrow the error to only the remaining reason variants after excluding the matched one.

symbols.name: ReasonOf
symbols.summary: Extracts the `reason` type from an error that has a `reason` field.
symbols.when: Use when an error type stores nested sub-errors in a `reason` field and you need that field's full union type as a standalone type.

symbols.name: ReasonTags
symbols.summary: Extracts the `_tag` values from the `reason` type of an error.
symbols.when: Use to get the discriminant values available inside a nested `reason` error union.

symbols.name: RequiredKeys
symbols.summary: Extracts the keys of required properties from a type.

symbols.name: Simplify
symbols.summary: Flattens an intersection type into a single object type for readability.
symbols.when: Use to clean up IDE tooltips that show `A & B & C` instead of a merged object.

symbols.name: Tags
symbols.summary: Extracts the `_tag` string literal types from a union.
symbols.when: Use to get all discriminant values from a tagged union type.

symbols.name: TupleOf
symbols.summary: Constructs a tuple type with exactly `N` elements of type `T`.
symbols.when: Use when you need a fixed-length array type, especially instead of manually writing `[T, T, T, ...]` for longer tuples.

symbols.name: TupleOfAtLeast
symbols.summary: Constructs a tuple type with at least `N` elements of type `T`.
symbols.when: Use when you need a minimum-length array type that still allows additional elements. This is useful for variadic function signatures that require a minimum arity.

symbols.name: unassigned
symbols.summary: Branded marker interface representing an unassigned type parameter.
symbols.when: Use when Effect's type-level machinery needs to represent a type parameter that has not been assigned yet.

symbols.name: unhandled
symbols.summary: Branded marker interface representing an unhandled error type.
symbols.when: Use when Effect's type-level machinery needs to represent an error type that has not been handled yet.

symbols.name: UnionToIntersection
symbols.summary: Transforms a union type into an intersection type.
symbols.when: Use to combine all members of a union into a single type with all their properties. This is useful in advanced generic code where you need to merge union variants.

symbols.name: VoidIfEmpty
symbols.summary: Conditional type that returns `void` if `S` is an empty object type, otherwise returns `S`.
symbols.when: Use to erase an empty object type from an API result or parameter position.

summary: Works with values that may be `undefined`.

symbols.name: getOrThrow
symbols.summary: Returns the defined value, or throws a default `Error` when the input is `undefined`.
symbols.when: Use when you need to unwrap a value that should already be defined and a generic missing-value `Error` is acceptable.

symbols.name: getOrThrowWith
symbols.summary: Returns the defined value, or throws the value produced by `onUndefined` when the input is `undefined`.
symbols.when: Use when you need fail-fast unwrapping of an `A | undefined` value and want to provide the thrown error for the undefined case.

symbols.name: liftThrowable
symbols.summary: Converts a throwing function into one that returns successful results unchanged and returns `undefined` when the function throws.
symbols.when: Use to adapt exception-throwing functions when `undefined` is the absence value you want to return for failures.

symbols.name: makeCombinerFailFast
symbols.summary: Creates a `Combiner` for `A | undefined` that combines values only when both operands are defined.
symbols.when: Use to lift a `Combiner` so any `undefined` operand makes the combined result `undefined`.

symbols.name: makeReducer
symbols.summary: Creates a `Reducer` for `UndefinedOr<A>` that prioritizes the first non-`undefined` value and combines values when both operands are present.
symbols.when: Use when you need to reduce values that may be `undefined`, keeping the first defined value as a fallback and combining only when both operands are defined.

symbols.name: makeReducerFailFast
symbols.summary: Creates a `Reducer` for `A | undefined` by wrapping an existing reducer with fail-fast semantics.
symbols.when: Use to wrap an existing `Reducer` so any `undefined` value aborts the entire reduction result.

symbols.name: map
symbols.summary: Maps a defined value with `f`, or returns `undefined` unchanged.
symbols.when: Use to apply a pure transformation to an `A | undefined` value while preserving `undefined` as absence.

symbols.name: match
symbols.summary: Pattern matches on an `A | undefined` value, running `onDefined` when the value is present or evaluating `onUndefined` when the value is `undefined`.
symbols.when: Use when you need to turn an `A | undefined` into a non-optional result by handling both the defined and undefined branches in one expression.

summary: Defines Effect's type-level unification protocol.

symbols.name: ignoreSymbol
symbols.summary: Defines the unique symbol used to specify types that should be ignored during unification.
symbols.when: Use to hide helper protocol entries from `Unify` when they should not contribute to the widened type.

symbols.name: typeSymbol
symbols.summary: Defines the unique symbol used to identify the type information for unification.
symbols.when: Use when you need a type-level protocol key that exposes the source type read by `Unify` from a protocol-enabled data type.

symbols.name: unify
symbols.summary: Applies `Unify` to a value or function return type at compile time.
symbols.when: Use to keep a value or function unchanged at runtime while normalizing its inferred type with Effect's unification protocol.

symbols.name: Unify
symbols.summary: Unifies types that implement the unification protocol.
symbols.when: Use to normalize unions of types that expose Effect's unification protocol.

symbols.name: unifySymbol
symbols.summary: Defines the unique symbol used to identify unification behavior in Effect types.
symbols.when: Use to define the widened type produced by the `Unify` protocol for a custom protocol-enabled data type.

summary: Internal and advanced utilities used by Effect's generator-based syntax and higher-kinded type support. This is not a general-purpose utility module for application code.

symbols.name: Gen
symbols.summary: Type-level signature for generator-based monadic composition over any `TypeLambda`.
symbols.when: Use to type the `gen` function of a module that supports generator syntax, such as `Option.gen`, `Result.gen`, and `Effect.gen`.

symbols.name: SingleShotGen
symbols.summary: Yields its wrapped value exactly once, then completes with the value sent back in.
symbols.when: Use to implement `[Symbol.iterator]()` on Effect-like types so they can be `yield*`-ed inside generator functions, such as `Effect.gen` and `Option.gen`.

symbols.name: Variance
symbols.summary: Type-level marker encoding the variance of a `TypeLambda`'s type parameters.
symbols.when: Use to define variance constraints for a higher-kinded type so that Gen can correctly infer `R`, `O`, and `E` from yielded values.

summary: The `effect` package version used in telemetry headers, resources, and scopes.

symbols.name: getCurrentVersion
symbols.summary: Returns the current version of the `effect` package.

symbols.name: setCurrentVersion
symbols.summary: Overrides the version returned by `getCurrentVersion`.

summary: Marks encoded worker message fields that should move through `postMessage` as transfer-list entries.

symbols.name: addAll
symbols.summary: Adds transferables to the current `Collector` when one is present in the context, and does nothing otherwise.

symbols.name: Collector
symbols.summary: Service for collecting `Transferable` objects while encoding worker messages so they can be passed to `postMessage` transfer lists.

symbols.name: getterAddAll
symbols.summary: Creates a schema getter that records transferables derived from a value in the current `Collector` while passing the value through unchanged.

symbols.name: ImageData
symbols.summary: Schema for transferring `ImageData` values with their pixel data buffer.

symbols.name: makeCollector
symbols.summary: Effect that creates a fresh `Collector` service for accumulating transferables.

symbols.name: makeCollectorUnsafe
symbols.summary: Creates a mutable `Collector` service directly, exposing unsafe synchronous methods for reading, adding, and clearing collected transferables.

symbols.name: MessagePort
symbols.summary: Schema for transferring `MessagePort` values as transferable objects.

symbols.name: schema
symbols.summary: Wraps a schema so encoding records transferables selected from the encoded value, enabling worker messages to populate a `postMessage` transfer list.

symbols.name: Transferable
symbols.summary: Schema wrapper whose encode path can record transferables with a `Collector` while preserving the wrapped schema's decoded type.

symbols.name: Uint8Array
symbols.summary: Schema for transferring `Uint8Array` values with their backing buffer.

summary: Client-side worker primitives shared by browser, Node, and Bun adapters.

symbols.name: layerSpawner
symbols.summary: Creates a layer that provides a worker `Spawner` service from a `SpawnerFn`.

symbols.name: makePlatform
symbols.summary: Creates a `WorkerPlatform` from platform-specific setup and listen hooks, buffering sent messages until the worker is ready and scoping port cleanup to the worker run.

symbols.name: makeUnsafe
symbols.summary: Wraps platform-specific send and run functions into a `Worker`, translating platform ready/data messages and running the optional `onSpawn` effect when the worker reports readiness.

symbols.name: PlatformMessage
symbols.summary: Internal worker platform protocol message: `[0]` signals readiness and `[1, payload]` carries data.

symbols.name: Spawner
symbols.summary: Phantom identifier for the service that maps worker ids to platform-specific worker instances. Service tag for the worker `SpawnerFn`.

symbols.name: SpawnerFn
symbols.summary: Function that creates or locates a platform-specific worker instance for a numeric worker id.

symbols.name: Worker
symbols.summary: Effect-based worker abstraction that can send input messages and run a long-lived handler for output messages, failing with `WorkerError` or handler errors.

symbols.name: WorkerPlatform
symbols.summary: Service that spawns effect `Worker` instances for numeric worker ids using the configured `Spawner`.

summary: Typed error model for worker APIs.

symbols.name: isWorkerError
symbols.summary: Returns `true` when a value is a `WorkerError`.

symbols.name: TypeId
symbols.summary: Type-level identifier used to brand `WorkerError` values.

symbols.name: WorkerError
symbols.summary: Error raised by worker APIs, wrapping a specific `WorkerErrorReason` and exposing its message and cause.

symbols.name: WorkerErrorReason
symbols.summary: Union of the specific failure reasons that can be wrapped by a `WorkerError`. Schema for decoding and encoding all supported worker error reason variants.

symbols.name: WorkerReceiveError
symbols.summary: Worker error reason for failures while receiving or handling a message from a worker.

symbols.name: WorkerSendError
symbols.summary: Worker error reason for failures while sending a message to a worker.

symbols.name: WorkerSpawnError
symbols.summary: Worker error reason for failures while spawning or setting up a worker.

symbols.name: WorkerUnknownError
symbols.summary: Worker error reason for an unclassified worker failure.

summary: Worker-side primitives for worker-like runtimes.

symbols.name: PlatformMessage
symbols.summary: Wire protocol message used by worker platforms: a request carrying input or a close signal.

symbols.name: WorkerRunner
symbols.summary: Platform-neutral worker runner that receives inbound messages by port ID, sends outbound messages, and optionally exposes disconnect notifications.

symbols.name: WorkerRunnerPlatform
symbols.summary: Context service that starts a platform-specific `WorkerRunner`.

summary: Defines named effects whose results can be stored by a workflow engine.

symbols.name: Activity
symbols.summary: Durable workflow activity that behaves as an `Effect` and records its name, result schemas, annotations, and encoded execution form for the workflow engine.

symbols.name: Any
symbols.summary: Type-erased activity shape for APIs that only need the activity identity, name, annotations, and encoded execution.

symbols.name: AnyWithProps
symbols.summary: Type-erased activity shape that also exposes success and error schemas for derived workflow APIs.

symbols.name: CurrentAttempt
symbols.summary: Context reference containing the current activity retry attempt, defaulting to `1`.

symbols.name: idempotencyKey
symbols.summary: Computes a deterministic activity idempotency key from the current workflow execution ID, the supplied name, and optionally the current attempt.

symbols.name: make
symbols.summary: Creates a workflow activity from an effect, using the provided schemas to encode successes and failures for durable execution.

symbols.name: raceAll
symbols.summary: Runs a non-empty collection of activities as a durable race and returns the first completed success or failure using unioned success and error schemas.

symbols.name: retry
symbols.summary: Retries an effect with `Effect.retry` while updating `CurrentAttempt` for each attempt.

summary: Durable timers for workflow sleeps.

symbols.name: DurableClock
symbols.summary: Represents a durable workflow timer with a name, duration, and deferred completed when the timer wakes.

symbols.name: make
symbols.summary: Creates a durable clock definition and its associated deferred wake-up signal.

symbols.name: sleep
symbols.summary: Waits inside a workflow, using an in-memory activity for durations at or below the threshold and scheduling a durable clock for longer durations.

summary: Defines named wait points for durable workflow executions.

symbols.name: Any
symbols.summary: Type-erased durable deferred shape for APIs that only need the deferred identity and name.

symbols.name: AnyWithProps
symbols.summary: Type-erased durable deferred shape that also exposes success, error, and exit schemas.

symbols.name: done
symbols.summary: Completes the durable deferred identified by a token with the supplied exit, encoding the result through the deferred schemas.

symbols.name: DurableDeferred
symbols.summary: Named durable deferred value whose completion is persisted by the workflow engine and encoded with success and error schemas.

symbols.name: fail
symbols.summary: Completes the durable deferred identified by a token with a typed failure.

symbols.name: failCause
symbols.summary: Completes the durable deferred identified by a token with a failure cause.

symbols.name: into
symbols.summary: Runs an effect and records its exit into the durable deferred, resuming workflows that are waiting on that deferred.

symbols.name: make
symbols.summary: Creates a named durable deferred with optional success and error schemas for persisted completion.

symbols.name: raceAll
symbols.summary: Runs effects as a durable race, returning a previously persisted result when present or completing a named deferred with the first result.

symbols.name: succeed
symbols.summary: Completes the durable deferred identified by a token with a successful value.

symbols.name: token
symbols.summary: Creates a token for a durable deferred using the current workflow instance's workflow name and execution ID.

symbols.name: Token
symbols.summary: Branded string token identifying a durable deferred for a workflow execution. Schema for branded durable deferred tokens.

symbols.name: tokenFromExecutionId
symbols.summary: Creates a durable deferred token from an explicit workflow, execution ID, and deferred name.

symbols.name: tokenFromPayload
symbols.summary: Creates a durable deferred token by deriving the workflow execution ID from the supplied workflow payload.

symbols.name: TokenParsed
symbols.summary: Schema for a decoded durable deferred token containing the workflow name, execution ID, and deferred name.

symbols.name: TokenTypeId
symbols.summary: Runtime brand identifier for durable deferred tokens. Type-level brand identifier for `Token` values.

summary: Durable workflow queues delegate work to persisted background workers and resume the waiting workflow with the worker result.

symbols.name: DurableQueue
symbols.summary: Durable workflow queue definition containing a payload schema, idempotency key, and deferred used to await worker results.

symbols.name: make
symbols.summary: Creates a `DurableQueue` that waits for persisted items to finish processing using a `DurableDeferred`.

symbols.name: makeWorker
symbols.summary: Create a worker effect that processes items from the durable queue.

symbols.name: process
symbols.summary: Adds an item to the queue and wait for a worker to process it.

symbols.name: TypeId
symbols.summary: Type-level identifier used to recognize `DurableQueue` values. Runtime identifier attached to `DurableQueue` values.

symbols.name: worker
symbols.summary: Create a layer that runs workers for the durable queue.

summary: Defines typed durable workflows.

symbols.name: addFinalizer
symbols.summary: Adds an exit finalizer to the current workflow scope, preserving the services available when the finalizer is registered.

symbols.name: Any
symbols.summary: Type-erased workflow shape for APIs that operate on workflows without preserving their specific payload, success, or error types.

symbols.name: AnyStructSchema
symbols.summary: Schema constraint for workflow payload schemas that expose struct fields.

symbols.name: AnyWithProps
symbols.summary: Type-erased workflow shape that also exposes executable operations needed by workflow proxy and engine helpers.

symbols.name: CaptureDefects
symbols.summary: Captures defects for a workflow and includes them in the result of the workflow or its activities.

symbols.name: Complete
symbols.summary: Represents a completed workflow execution with its success or failure `Exit`.

symbols.name: CompleteEncoded
symbols.summary: Encoded representation of a completed workflow result containing an encoded `Exit`.

symbols.name: CompleteSchema
symbols.summary: Schema constructor for `Complete` workflow results using the supplied success and error schemas.

symbols.name: Execution
symbols.summary: Type-level marker for services associated with a specific workflow execution tag.

symbols.name: intoResult
symbols.summary: Runs an effect as a workflow execution and converts its outcome into a `Result`, handling suspension, defect capture, interruption, and workflow scope finalization.

symbols.name: isResult
symbols.summary: Returns `true` when a value is a workflow `Result`.

symbols.name: make
symbols.summary: Creates a durable workflow definition with schemas, annotations, and deterministic execution IDs derived from the workflow tag and idempotency key.

symbols.name: PayloadSchema
symbols.summary: Extracts the payload schema from a `Workflow`.

symbols.name: provideScope
symbols.summary: Provides the workflow scope to the given effect, and closes the scope only when the workflow execution fully completes.

symbols.name: RequirementsClient
symbols.summary: Computes the schema services required by clients that execute or poll workflows.

symbols.name: RequirementsHandler
symbols.summary: Computes the schema services required by handlers that decode workflow payloads and encode workflow results.

symbols.name: Result
symbols.summary: Result of a workflow execution, either a completed exit or a suspended workflow state. Creates a schema for workflow results using the supplied success and error schemas.

symbols.name: ResultEncoded
symbols.summary: Encoded representation of a workflow `Result`. Schema for encoded workflow results with generic success and error payloads.

symbols.name: scope
symbols.summary: Accesses the workflow scope, which is only closed when the workflow execution fully completes.

symbols.name: suspend
symbols.summary: Marks a workflow instance as suspended and interrupts the current fiber to stop execution until it is resumed.

symbols.name: Suspended
symbols.summary: Represents a suspended workflow execution, optionally carrying the cause that triggered suspension.

symbols.name: SuspendOnFailure
symbols.summary: Marks a workflow to suspend when it encounters any error.

symbols.name: withCompensation
symbols.summary: Adds compensation logic to an effect inside a Workflow.
symbols.when: Use when a top-level workflow step needs compensating cleanup if the overall workflow later fails after the step succeeds.

symbols.name: Workflow
symbols.summary: Durable workflow definition with typed payload, success, and error schemas plus operations for execution, polling, interruption, resumption, and registration.

symbols.name: wrapActivityResult
symbols.summary: Wraps an activity-like effect so workflow suspension waits for currently running activities to finish or suspend.

summary: Defines workflow engine services and an in-memory implementation.

symbols.name: DeferredState
symbols.summary: Tracks live workflow runs so deferred completions can wake them.

symbols.name: Encoded
symbols.summary: Low-level workflow engine contract that works with encoded payloads and results before `makeUnsafe` adds typed schema decoding and encoding.

symbols.name: layerMemory
symbols.summary: Layer that provides an in-memory `WorkflowEngine`.
symbols.when: Use to run tests and local development workflows where durability is not needed.

symbols.name: makeDeferredState
symbols.summary: Creates deferred state shared by workflow engines.

symbols.name: makeUnsafe
symbols.summary: Builds a typed `WorkflowEngine` service from a low-level encoded implementation.
symbols.when: Use when wiring a trusted low-level workflow engine implementation into the typed `WorkflowEngine` service.

symbols.name: WorkflowEngine
symbols.summary: Service that represents workflow runtimes, responsible for registering and executing workflows and coordinating activities, durable deferreds, interrupts, resumes, and clocks.

symbols.name: WorkflowInstance
symbols.summary: Service that contains workflow runtime state for one execution.
symbols.when: Use to read or update workflow execution, suspension, interruption, lifetime, failure, and activity coordination state inside workflow engine internals.

summary: RPC and HTTP API definitions for workflows.

symbols.name: ConvertHttpApi
symbols.summary: Maps each workflow to the HTTP API endpoints generated for execute, discard, and resume operations.

symbols.name: ConvertRpcs
symbols.summary: Maps each workflow to the RPC definitions generated for execute, discard, and resume operations.

symbols.name: toHttpApiGroup
symbols.summary: Derives an `HttpApiGroup` from a list of workflows.

symbols.name: toRpcGroup
symbols.summary: Derives an `RpcGroup` from a list of workflows.

summary: Server-side layers for workflow proxy APIs.

symbols.name: layerHttpApi
symbols.summary: Creates handlers for a workflow HTTP API group, wiring execute, discard, and resume endpoints to the supplied workflows.

symbols.name: layerRpcHandlers
symbols.summary: Creates RPC handlers for the supplied workflows, wiring execute, discard, and resume RPCs to workflow operations.

symbols.name: RpcHandlers
symbols.summary: Union of RPC handler services required to serve the generated workflow execute, discard, and resume RPCs.
